   128→            self.nodes[node.node_id] = node
   129→        
   130→        # Load gates with connections
   131→        for gate_data in config.get("gates", []):
   132→            gate_id = gate_data["gate_id"]
   133→            upstream = gate_data["upstream_node"]
   134→            downstream = gate_data["downstream_node"]
   135→            self.gates[gate_id] = (upstream, downstream)
   136→            
   137→            # Create gate properties
   138→            props = GateProperties(
   139→                gate_id=gate_id,
   140→                gate_type=GateType(gate_data.get("gate_type", "sluice_gate")),
   141→                width_m=gate_data["width_m"],
   142→                height_m=gate_data["height_m"],
   143→                sill_elevation_m=gate_data["sill_elevation_m"],
   144→                has_drop_structure=gate_data.get("has_drop_structure", False),
   145→                drop_height_m=gate_data.get("drop_height_m", 0.0),
   146→                drop_type=gate_data.get("drop_type", "none")
   147→            )
   148→            self.hydraulics.add_gate_properties(props)
   149→            
   150→            # Add calibration if provided
   151→            if "calibration" in gate_data:
   152→                cal_data = gate_data["calibration"]
   153→                calibration = GateCalibration(
   154→                    gate_id=gate_id,
   155→                    K1=cal_data["K1"],
   156→                    K2=cal_data["K2"],
   157→                    confidence=cal_data.get("confidence", 0.9),
   158→                    calibration_date=datetime.fromisoformat(cal_data["date"]) if "date" in cal_data else None
   159→                )
   160→                self.hydraulics.add_gate_calibration(calibration)
   161→        
   162→        # Load canal sections
   163→        for canal_data in config.get("canals", []):
   164→            canal = CanalSection(**canal_data)
   165→            self.canals[canal.section_id] = canal
   166→    
   167→    def _initialize_gates(self):
   168→        """Initialize gate properties from registry"""
   169→        # Add automated gates
   170→        for gate_id in self.gate_registry.get_automated_gates_list():
   171→            if gate_id not in self.gates:
   172→                logger.warning(f"Automated gate {gate_id} not found in network topology")
   173→        
   174→        # Verify all gates in topology are in registry
   175→        for gate_id in self.gates:
   176→            if not (self.gate_registry.is_automated(gate_id) or 
   177→                   gate_id in self.gate_registry.manual_gates):
   178→                logger.warning(f"Gate {gate_id} not found in gate registry")
   179→    
   180→    def set_initial_conditions(self, water_levels: Dict[str, float], 
   181→                             gate_openings: Dict[str, float]):
   182→        """Set initial water levels and gate openings"""
   183→        # Initialize state
   184→        self.current_state = HydraulicState(
   185→            timestamp=datetime.now(),
   186→            water_levels=water_levels.copy(),
   187→            gate_flows={},
   188→            gate_openings=gate_openings.copy(),
   189→            canal_flows={},
   190→            node_demands={}
   191→        )
   192→        
   193→        # Set default water levels for missing nodes
   194→        for node_id, node in self.nodes.items():
   195→            if node_id not in self.current_state.water_levels:
   196→                # Default to minimum operational level
   197→                self.current_state.water_levels[node_id] = node.elevation_m + node.min_depth_m
   198→        
   199→        logger.info("Initial conditions set for hydraulic solver")
   200→    
   201→    def update_demands(self, demands: Dict[str, float]):
   202→        """Update water demands at delivery nodes"""
   203→        if self.current_state:
   204→            self.current_state.node_demands.update(demands)
   205→        
   206→        # Update node objects
   207→        for node_id, demand in demands.items():
   208→            if node_id in self.nodes:
   209→                self.nodes[node_id].demand_m3s = demand
   210→    
   211→    def calculate_gate_flow(self, gate_id: str) -> float:
   212→        """Calculate flow through a gate using calibrated equation"""
   213→        if gate_id not in self.gates:
   214→            return 0.0
   215→        
   216→        upstream, downstream = self.gates[gate_id]
   217→        
   218→        # Get current conditions
   219→        conditions = HydraulicConditions(
   220→            upstream_water_level_m=self.current_state.water_levels.get(upstream, 0),
   221→            downstream_water_level_m=self.current_state.water_levels.get(downstream, 0),
   222→            gate_opening_m=self.current_state.gate_openings.get(gate_id, 0),
   223→            timestamp=datetime.now()
   224→        )
   225→        
   226→        # Check if gate is operational
   227→        gate_mode = self.gate_registry.get_gate_mode(gate_id)
   228→        if gate_mode == ControlMode.FAILED:
   229→            self.current_state.warnings.append(f"Gate {gate_id} is in FAILED mode")
   230→            return 0.0
   231→        
   232→        # Calculate flow using calibrated hydraulics
   233→        result = self.hydraulics.calculate_gate_flow(gate_id, conditions)
   234→        
   235→        # Add warnings to state
   236→        if result.warnings:
   237→            self.current_state.warnings.extend([f"Gate {gate_id}: {w}" for w in result.warnings])
   238→        
   239→        return result.flow_rate_m3s
   240→    
   241→    def calculate_canal_flow(self, section_id: str) -> float:
   242→        """Calculate flow in canal section using Manning's equation"""
   243→        if section_id not in self.canals:
   244→            return 0.0
   245→        
   246→        canal = self.canals[section_id]
   247→        
   248→        # Get water levels
   249→        h_upstream = self.current_state.water_levels.get(canal.upstream_node, 0)
   250→        h_downstream = self.current_state.water_levels.get(canal.downstream_node, 0)
   251→        
   252→        # Get node elevations
   253→        z_upstream = self.nodes[canal.upstream_node].elevation_m
   254→        z_downstream = self.nodes[canal.downstream_node].elevation_m
   255→        
   256→        # Calculate depths
   257→        y_upstream = h_upstream - z_upstream
   258→        y_downstream = h_downstream - z_downstream
   259→        
   260→        if y_upstream <= 0 and y_downstream <= 0:
   261→            return 0.0
   262→        
   263→        # Average depth and hydraulic parameters
   264→        y_avg = (y_upstream + y_downstream) / 2
   265→        if y_avg <= 0:
   266→            return 0.0
   267→        
   268→        # Trapezoidal channel geometry
   269→        b = canal.bottom_width_m
   270→        m = canal.side_slope
   271→        
   272→        # Flow area and wetted perimeter
   273→        A = y_avg * (b + m * y_avg)
   274→        P = b + 2 * y_avg * np.sqrt(1 + m**2)
   275→        
   276→        # Hydraulic radius
   277→        R = A / P if P > 0 else 0
   278→        
   279→        # Energy slope (approximate)
   280→        Sf = ((h_upstream - h_downstream) / canal.length_m) - canal.bed_slope
   281→        
   282→        if Sf <= 0:
   283→            # Adverse slope - use minimum slope
   284→            Sf = 0.0001
   285→        
   286→        # Manning's equation: V = (1/n) * R^(2/3) * Sf^(1/2)
   287→        V = (1 / canal.manning_n) * (R ** (2/3)) * (Sf ** 0.5)
   288→        
   289→        # Flow rate
   290→        Q = A * V
   291→        
   292→        return Q
   293→    
   294→    def calculate_node_continuity(self, node_id: str) -> float:
   295→        """
   296→        Calculate flow imbalance at a node (mass balance)
   297→        Returns: inflow - outflow - demand (positive = excess)
   298→        """
   299→        if node_id not in self.nodes:
   300→            return 0.0
   301→        
   302→        inflow = 0.0
   303→        outflow = 0.0
   304→        
   305→        # Sum gate flows
   306→        for gate_id, (upstream, downstream) in self.gates.items():
   307→            flow = self.current_state.gate_flows.get(gate_id, 0)
   308→            
   309→            if downstream == node_id:
   310→                inflow += flow
   311→            elif upstream == node_id:
   312→                outflow += flow
   313→        
   314→        # Sum canal flows
   315→        for section_id, canal in self.canals.items():
   316→            flow = self.current_state.canal_flows.get(section_id, 0)
   317→            
   318→            if canal.downstream_node == node_id:
   319→                inflow += flow
   320→            elif canal.upstream_node == node_id:
   321→                outflow += flow
   322→        
   323→        # Account for demand
   324→        demand = self.nodes[node_id].demand_m3s
   325→        
   326→        # Special handling for reservoir nodes
   327→        if self.nodes[node_id].node_type == NetworkNodeType.RESERVOIR:
   328→            # Reservoir can supply any required flow
   329→            return 0.0
   330→        
   331→        return inflow - outflow - demand
   332→    
   333→    def update_water_level(self, node_id: str, continuity_error: float, dt: float):
   334→        """Update water level based on continuity error"""
   335→        if node_id not in self.nodes:
   336→            return
   337→        
   338→        node = self.nodes[node_id]
   339→        
   340→        # Skip reservoir nodes
   341→        if node.node_type == NetworkNodeType.RESERVOIR:
   342→            return
   343→        
   344→        # Calculate level change
   345→        dh = (continuity_error * dt) / node.surface_area_m2
   346→        
   347→        # Apply with relaxation
   348→        if self.settings.use_adaptive_relaxation:
   349→            # Reduce relaxation factor if oscillating
   350→            if hasattr(self, '_prev_errors') and node_id in self._prev_errors:
   351→                if np.sign(continuity_error) != np.sign(self._prev_errors[node_id]):
   352→                    # Oscillation detected
   353→                    relaxation = self.settings.relaxation_factor * 0.5
   354→                else:
   355→                    relaxation = self.settings.relaxation_factor
   356→            else:
   357→                relaxation = self.settings.relaxation_factor
   358→                self._prev_errors = {}
   359→            
   360→            self._prev_errors[node_id] = continuity_error
   361→        else:
   362→            relaxation = self.settings.relaxation_factor
   363→        
   364→        # Update level
   365→        new_level = self.current_state.water_levels[node_id] + relaxation * dh
   366→        
   367→        # Apply constraints
   368→        min_level = node.elevation_m + node.min_depth_m
   369→        max_level = node.elevation_m + node.max_depth_m
   370→        
   371→        self.current_state.water_levels[node_id] = np.clip(new_level, min_level, max_level)
   372→    
   373→    def solve_steady_state(self, target_demands: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None) -> HydraulicState:
   374→        """
   375→        Solve for steady-state water levels and flows
   376→        
   377→        Args:
   378→            target_demands: Optional demand overrides
   379→            
   380→        Returns:
   381→            Converged hydraulic state
   382→        """
   383→        if self.current_state is None:
   384→            raise ValueError("Initial conditions not set. Call set_initial_conditions first.")
   385→        
   386→        # Update demands if provided
   387→        if target_demands:
   388→            self.update_demands(target_demands)
   389→        
   390→        # Store initial state for comparison
   391→        initial_levels = self.current_state.water_levels.copy()
   392→        
   393→        # Reset warnings
   394→        self.current_state.warnings = []
   395→        
   396→        # Iterative solution
   397→        converged = False
   398→        iteration = 0
   399→        mass_balance_errors = []
   400→        
   401→        logger.info("Starting steady-state hydraulic solution...")
   402→        
   403→        while iteration < self.settings.max_iterations and not converged:
   404→            iteration += 1
   405→            
   406→            # Store previous levels
   407→            prev_levels = self.current_state.water_levels.copy()
   408→            
   409→            # Step 1: Update all gate flows
   410→            for gate_id in self.gates:
   411→                self.current_state.gate_flows[gate_id] = self.calculate_gate_flow(gate_id)
   412→            
   413→            # Step 2: Update all canal flows
   414→            for section_id in self.canals:
   415→                self.current_state.canal_flows[section_id] = self.calculate_canal_flow(section_id)
   416→            
   417→            # Step 3: Check mass balance at each node
   418→            total_imbalance = 0.0
   419→            node_errors = {}
   420→            
   421→            for node_id in self.nodes:
   422→                if self.nodes[node_id].node_type == NetworkNodeType.RESERVOIR:
   423→                    continue
   424→                
   425→                # Calculate continuity error
   426→                error = self.calculate_node_continuity(node_id)
   427→                node_errors[node_id] = error
   428→                total_imbalance += abs(error)
   429→                
   430→                # Update water level
   431→                self.update_water_level(node_id, error, self.settings.min_time_step_s)
   432→            
   433→            mass_balance_errors.append(total_imbalance)
   434→            
   435→            # Step 4: Check convergence
   436→            max_change = 0.0
   437→            for node_id in self.nodes:
   438→                if self.nodes[node_id].node_type != NetworkNodeType.RESERVOIR:
   439→                    change = abs(self.current_state.water_levels[node_id] - prev_levels[node_id])
   440→                    max_change = max(max_change, change)
   441→            
   442→            # Log progress
   443→            if iteration % 10 == 0 or iteration == 1:
   444→                logger.info(f"Iteration {iteration}: Max level change = {max_change:.4f}m, "
   445→                          f"Mass balance error = {total_imbalance:.3f} m³/s")
   446→            
   447→            # Check convergence criteria
   448→            if max_change < self.settings.convergence_tolerance_m:
   449→                # Additional mass balance check
   450→                if self.settings.check_mass_balance:
   451→                    total_inflow = sum(self.current_state.gate_flows.values()) + \
   452→                                  sum(self.current_state.canal_flows.values())
   453→                    total_demand = sum(node.demand_m3s for node in self.nodes.values())
   454→                    
   455→                    if total_inflow > 0:
   456→                        balance_error = abs(total_inflow - total_demand) / total_inflow
   457→                        if balance_error < self.settings.mass_balance_tolerance:
   458→                            converged = True
   459→                        else:
   460→                            self.current_state.warnings.append(
   461→                                f"Mass balance error {balance_error:.1%} exceeds tolerance"
   462→                            )
   463→                else:
   464→                    converged = True
   465→        
   466→        # Update convergence status
   467→        self.current_state.convergence_achieved = converged
   468→        self.current_state.iterations = iteration
   469→        self.current_state.max_error = max_change
   470→        
   471→        if not converged:
   472→            self.current_state.warnings.append(
   473→                f"Solution did not converge after {iteration} iterations"
   474→            )
   475→        
   476→        # Log final results
   477→        logger.info(f"Hydraulic solution {'converged' if converged else 'stopped'} "
   478→                   f"after {iteration} iterations")
   479→        
   480→        # Check for dry nodes or other issues
   481→        for node_id, node in self.nodes.items():
   482→            if node.node_type == NetworkNodeType.RESERVOIR:
   483→                continue
   484→            
   485→            depth = self.current_state.water_levels[node_id] - node.elevation_m
   486→            if depth < node.min_depth_m * 1.5:
   487→                self.current_state.warnings.append(
   488→                    f"Node {node_id} water depth critically low: {depth:.2f}m"
   489→                )
   490→        
   491→        return self.current_state
   492→    
   493→    def simulate_gate_change(self, gate_id: str, new_opening: float, 
   494→                           transition_time_s: float = 300) -> List[HydraulicState]:
   495→        """
   496→        Simulate gradual gate opening change
   497→        
   498→        Args:
   499→            gate_id: Gate to adjust
   500→            new_opening: Target opening (m)
   501→            transition_time_s: Time for transition
   502→            
   503→        Returns:
   504→            List of states during transition
   505→        """
   506→        if self.current_state is None:
   507→            raise ValueError("No current state available")
   508→        
   509→        if gate_id not in self.gates:
   510→            raise ValueError(f"Gate {gate_id} not found")
   511→        
   512→        # Check if gate is operational
   513→        mode = self.gate_registry.get_gate_mode(gate_id)
   514→        if mode == ControlMode.FAILED:
   515→            logger.warning(f"Cannot adjust failed gate {gate_id}")
   516→            return [self.current_state]
   517→        
   518→        # Get current opening
   519→        current_opening = self.current_state.gate_openings.get(gate_id, 0)
   520→        
   521→        # Calculate steps
   522→        opening_change = new_opening - current_opening
   523→        num_steps = max(int(transition_time_s / self.settings.min_time_step_s), 1)
   524→        
   525→        states = []
   526→        
   527→        for step in range(num_steps + 1):
   528→            # Calculate intermediate opening
   529→            progress = step / num_steps
   530→            intermediate_opening = current_opening + progress * opening_change
   531→            
   532→            # Update gate opening
   533→            self.current_state.gate_openings[gate_id] = intermediate_opening
   534→            
   535→            # Solve hydraulics
   536→            state = self.solve_steady_state()
   537→            states.append(HydraulicState(
   538→                timestamp=state.timestamp,
   539→                water_levels=state.water_levels.copy(),
   540→                gate_flows=state.gate_flows.copy(),
   541→                gate_openings=state.gate_openings.copy(),
   542→                canal_flows=state.canal_flows.copy(),
   543→                node_demands=state.node_demands.copy(),
   544→                convergence_achieved=state.convergence_achieved,
   545→                iterations=state.iterations,
   546→                max_error=state.max_error,
   547→                warnings=state.warnings.copy()
   548→            ))
   549→        
   550→        return states
   551→    
   552→    def export_state(self) -> Dict:
   553→        """Export current hydraulic state"""
   554→        if self.current_state is None:
   555→            return {}
   556→        
   557→        return {
   558→            "timestamp": self.current_state.timestamp.isoformat(),
   559→            "water_levels": self.current_state.water_levels,
   560→            "gate_flows": self.current_state.gate_flows,
   561→            "gate_openings": self.current_state.gate_openings,
   562→            "canal_flows": self.current_state.canal_flows,

   100→    """
   101→    
   102→    def __init__(self, hydraulic_solver, gate_registry, constraints: Optional[TransitionConstraints] = None):
   103→        """
   104→        Initialize transition controller
   105→        
   106→        Args:
   107→            hydraulic_solver: Enhanced hydraulic solver instance
   108→            gate_registry: Gate registry for equipment limits
   109→            constraints: Transition constraints
   110→        """
   111→        self.hydraulic_solver = hydraulic_solver
   112→        self.gate_registry = gate_registry
   113→        self.constraints = constraints or TransitionConstraints()
   114→        
   115→        # Monitoring state
   116→        self._active_transitions: Dict[str, GateTransitionPlan] = {}
   117→        self._monitoring_history: deque = deque(maxlen=1000)
   118→        self._oscillation_detectors: Dict[str, deque] = {}
   119→        
   120→        # Initialize oscillation detectors for each node
   121→        for node_id in hydraulic_solver.nodes:
   122→            self._oscillation_detectors[node_id] = deque(maxlen=10)
   123→        
   124→        logger.info("Gradual transition controller initialized")
   125→    
   126→    async def create_transition_plan(
   127→        self,
   128→        gate_transitions: Dict[str, float],  # gate_id -> target_position
   129→        target_duration_s: Optional[float] = None,
   130→        strategy: TransitionStrategy = TransitionStrategy.S_CURVE,
   131→        priority_zones: Optional[List[str]] = None
   132→    ) -> SystemTransitionPlan:
   133→        """
   134→        Create a coordinated transition plan for multiple gates
   135→        
   136→        Args:
   137→            gate_transitions: Target positions for each gate
   138→            target_duration_s: Desired transition duration
   139→            strategy: Transition strategy to use
   140→            priority_zones: Zones requiring special protection
   141→            
   142→        Returns:
   143→            SystemTransitionPlan with detailed steps
   144→        """
   145→        plan_id = f"TP-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}"
   146→        gate_plans = {}
   147→        
   148→        # Analyze initial conditions
   149→        initial_state = self.hydraulic_solver.current_state
   150→        if not initial_state:
   151→            raise ValueError("No current hydraulic state available")
   152→        
   153→        # Calculate required transition time for each gate
   154→        transition_times = {}
   155→        for gate_id, target_pos in gate_transitions.items():
   156→            current_pos = initial_state.gate_openings.get(gate_id, 0)
   157→            required_time = self._calculate_minimum_transition_time(
   158→                gate_id, current_pos, target_pos
   159→            )
   160→            transition_times[gate_id] = required_time
   161→        
   162→        # Use longest required time if not specified
   163→        if target_duration_s is None:
   164→            target_duration_s = max(transition_times.values())
   165→        else:
   166→            # Ensure target duration meets minimum requirements
   167→            min_required = max(transition_times.values())
   168→            if target_duration_s < min_required:
   169→                logger.warning(f"Requested duration {target_duration_s}s is less than "
   170→                             f"minimum required {min_required}s. Using minimum.")
   171→                target_duration_s = min_required
   172→        
   173→        # Apply maximum duration constraint
   174→        target_duration_s = min(target_duration_s, self.constraints.max_transition_time_s)
   175→        
   176→        # Create individual gate plans
   177→        for gate_id, target_pos in gate_transitions.items():
   178→            current_pos = initial_state.gate_openings.get(gate_id, 0)
   179→            
   180→            gate_plan = await self._create_gate_transition_plan(
   181→                gate_id, current_pos, target_pos, target_duration_s, strategy
   182→            )
   183→            gate_plans[gate_id] = gate_plan
   184→        
   185→        # Coordinate gate movements to prevent conflicts
   186→        gate_plans = await self._coordinate_transitions(gate_plans, priority_zones)
   187→        
   188→        # Calculate safety buffers
   189→        safety_buffers = await self._calculate_safety_buffers(gate_plans, priority_zones)
   190→        
   191→        # Predict system impacts
   192→        expected_impacts = await self._predict_transition_impacts(gate_plans)
   193→        
   194→        return SystemTransitionPlan(
   195→            plan_id=plan_id,
   196→            created_at=datetime.now(),
   197→            total_duration_s=target_duration_s,
   198→            gate_plans=gate_plans,
   199→            coordination_strategy="upstream_first" if priority_zones else "balanced",
   200→            safety_buffers=safety_buffers,
   201→            expected_impacts=expected_impacts
   202→        )
   203→    
   204→    async def execute_transition_plan(
   205→        self,
   206→        plan: SystemTransitionPlan,
   207→        monitoring_interval_s: float = 1.0
   208→    ) -> Dict[str, any]:
   209→        """
   210→        Execute a transition plan with real-time monitoring
   211→        
   212→        Args:
   213→            plan: Transition plan to execute
   214→            monitoring_interval_s: How often to check system state
   215→            
   216→        Returns:
   217→            Execution summary with results
   218→        """
   219→        logger.info(f"Starting execution of transition plan {plan.plan_id}")
   220→        
   221→        # Store active transitions
   222→        for gate_id, gate_plan in plan.gate_plans.items():
   223→            self._active_transitions[gate_id] = gate_plan
   224→        
   225→        start_time = datetime.now()
   226→        execution_results = {
   227→            "plan_id": plan.plan_id,
   228→            "start_time": start_time,
   229→            "completed": False,
   230→            "emergency_stops": [],
   231→            "anomalies": [],
   232→            "final_positions": {}
   233→        }
   234→        
   235→        try:
   236→            # Execute transitions with monitoring
   237→            await self._execute_with_monitoring(
   238→                plan, monitoring_interval_s, execution_results
   239→            )
   240→            
   241→            execution_results["completed"] = True
   242→            execution_results["end_time"] = datetime.now()
   243→            execution_results["duration_s"] = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
   244→            
   245→        except Exception as e:
   246→            logger.error(f"Transition execution failed: {e}")
   247→            execution_results["error"] = str(e)
   248→            
   249→            # Emergency stop all gates
   250→            await self._emergency_stop_all()
   251→            
   252→        finally:
   253→            # Clear active transitions
   254→            for gate_id in plan.gate_plans:
   255→                self._active_transitions.pop(gate_id, None)
   256→        
   257→        return execution_results
   258→    
   259→    def _calculate_minimum_transition_time(
   260→        self,
   261→        gate_id: str,
   262→        current_pos: float,
   263→        target_pos: float
   264→    ) -> float:
   265→        """Calculate minimum safe transition time for a gate"""
   266→        position_change = abs(target_pos - current_pos)
   267→        
   268→        # Get gate properties
   269→        gate_props = self.hydraulic_solver.hydraulics.gate_properties.get(gate_id)
   270→        if not gate_props:
   271→            # Use conservative estimate
   272→            height = 2.0  # meters
   273→        else:
   274→            height = gate_props.height_m
   275→        
   276→        # Convert to percentage change
   277→        percent_change = (position_change / height) * 100
   278→        
   279→        # Calculate based on maximum speed constraint
   280→        min_time_speed = percent_change / self.constraints.max_gate_speed_percent_per_sec
   281→        
   282→        # Calculate based on flow change constraint
   283→        # Estimate flow change (simplified)
   284→        estimated_flow_change = position_change * 2.0  # m³/s rough estimate
   285→        min_time_flow = (estimated_flow_change / self.constraints.max_flow_change_m3s_per_min) * 60
   286→        
   287→        # Use the most conservative estimate
   288→        min_time = max(
   289→            min_time_speed,
   290→            min_time_flow,
   291→            self.constraints.min_transition_time_s
   292→        )
   293→        
   294→        return min_time
   295→    
   296→    async def _create_gate_transition_plan(
   297→        self,
   298→        gate_id: str,
   299→        start_pos: float,
   300→        target_pos: float,
   301→        duration_s: float,
   302→        strategy: TransitionStrategy
   303→    ) -> GateTransitionPlan:
   304→        """Create transition plan for a single gate"""
   305→        plan = GateTransitionPlan(
   306→            gate_id=gate_id,
   307→            start_position=start_pos,
   308→            target_position=target_pos,
   309→            strategy=strategy,
   310→            duration_s=duration_s
   311→        )
   312→        
   313→        # Generate transition steps based on strategy
   314→        num_steps = max(int(duration_s / 10), 10)  # At least 10 steps
   315→        
   316→        for i in range(num_steps + 1):
   317→            progress = i / num_steps
   318→            time_offset = duration_s * progress
   319→            
   320→            # Calculate position based on strategy
   321→            if strategy == TransitionStrategy.LINEAR:
   322→                position_factor = progress
   323→            elif strategy == TransitionStrategy.EXPONENTIAL:
   324→                position_factor = 1 - np.exp(-3 * progress)
   325→            elif strategy == TransitionStrategy.S_CURVE:
   326→                # Sigmoid function
   327→                position_factor = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-10 * (progress - 0.5)))
   328→            else:  # ADAPTIVE
   329→                position_factor = progress  # Will be adjusted in real-time
   330→            
   331→            position = start_pos + (target_pos - start_pos) * position_factor
   332→            
   333→            # Calculate allowed speed for this step
   334→            if i > 0:
   335→                prev_position = plan.steps[-1].gate_position
   336→                time_delta = time_offset - plan.steps[-1].time_offset_s
   337→                speed = abs(position - prev_position) / time_delta if time_delta > 0 else 0
   338→                
   339→                # Apply speed limit
   340→                gate_height = self.hydraulic_solver.hydraulics.gate_properties.get(gate_id).height_m
   341→                max_speed = (self.constraints.max_gate_speed_percent_per_sec / 100) * gate_height
   342→                
   343→                if speed > max_speed:
   344→                    # Reduce position change to meet speed limit
   345→                    max_change = max_speed * time_delta
   346→                    if position > prev_position:
   347→                        position = prev_position + max_change
   348→                    else:
   349→                        position = prev_position - max_change
   350→                    plan.constraints_applied.append(f"Speed limit at step {i}")
   351→            else:
   352→                max_speed = self.constraints.max_gate_speed_percent_per_sec
   353→            
   354→            step = TransitionStep(
   355→                step_number=i,
   356→                time_offset_s=time_offset,
   357→                gate_position=position,
   358→                expected_flow=0,  # Will be calculated later
   359→                max_allowed_speed=max_speed
   360→            )
   361→            
   362→            plan.steps.append(step)
   363→        
   364→        # Calculate expected flows for each step
   365→        await self._calculate_expected_flows(plan)
   366→        
   367→        return plan
   368→    
   369→    async def _calculate_expected_flows(self, plan: GateTransitionPlan):
   370→        """Calculate expected flow rates for each transition step"""
   371→        for step in plan.steps:
   372→            # Simple estimation - would use hydraulic solver in production
   373→            gate_props = self.hydraulic_solver.hydraulics.gate_properties.get(plan.gate_id)
   374→            if gate_props:
   375→                # Rough flow estimate
   376→                step.expected_flow = step.gate_position * gate_props.width_m * 1.0  # Simplified
   377→    
   378→    async def _coordinate_transitions(
   379→        self,
   380→        gate_plans: Dict[str, GateTransitionPlan],
   381→        priority_zones: Optional[List[str]] = None
   382→    ) -> Dict[str, GateTransitionPlan]:
   383→        """Coordinate multiple gate transitions to prevent conflicts"""
   384→        
   385→        # Identify gate dependencies based on hydraulic network
   386→        dependencies = self._identify_gate_dependencies()
   387→        
   388→        # Apply coordination rules
   389→        for gate_id, plan in gate_plans.items():
   390→            # Rule 1: Upstream gates move first
   391→            upstream_gates = dependencies.get(gate_id, {}).get("upstream", [])
   392→            for upstream_id in upstream_gates:
   393→                if upstream_id in gate_plans:
   394→                    # Add delay to downstream gate
   395→                    delay = 30.0  # 30 second delay
   396→                    for step in plan.steps:
   397→                        step.time_offset_s += delay
   398→                    plan.constraints_applied.append(f"Delayed for upstream gate {upstream_id}")
   399→            
   400→            # Rule 2: Protect priority zones
   401→            if priority_zones and self._affects_priority_zone(gate_id, priority_zones):
   402→                # Slow down transitions affecting priority zones
   403→                for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
   404→                    if i > 0:
   405→                        step.hold_duration_s = 5.0  # 5 second hold between steps
   406→                plan.constraints_applied.append("Slowed for priority zone protection")
   407→        
   408→        return gate_plans
   409→    
   410→    def _identify_gate_dependencies(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, List[str]]]:
   411→        """Identify hydraulic dependencies between gates"""
   412→        dependencies = {}
   413→        
   414→        for gate_id, (upstream_node, downstream_node) in self.hydraulic_solver.gates.items():
   415→            dependencies[gate_id] = {
   416→                "upstream": [],
   417→                "downstream": []
   418→            }
   419→            
   420→            # Find upstream gates
   421→            for other_id, (other_up, other_down) in self.hydraulic_solver.gates.items():
   422→                if other_id != gate_id:
   423→                    if other_down == upstream_node:
   424→                        dependencies[gate_id]["upstream"].append(other_id)
   425→                    elif other_up == downstream_node:
   426→                        dependencies[gate_id]["downstream"].append(other_id)
   427→        
   428→        return dependencies
   429→    
   430→    def _affects_priority_zone(self, gate_id: str, priority_zones: List[str]) -> bool:
   431→        """Check if gate affects priority zones"""
   432→        # Simplified check - would trace actual flow paths in production
   433→        if gate_id in self.hydraulic_solver.gates:
   434→            _, downstream = self.hydraulic_solver.gates[gate_id]
   435→            return any(zone in downstream for zone in priority_zones)
   436→        return False
   437→    
   438→    async def _calculate_safety_buffers(
   439→        self,
   440→        gate_plans: Dict[str, GateTransitionPlan],
   441→        priority_zones: Optional[List[str]] = None
   442→    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
   443→        """Calculate water buffers needed for safe transitions"""
   444→        buffers = {}
   445→        
   446→        # For each node, calculate potential flow variations
   447→        for node_id in self.hydraulic_solver.nodes:
   448→            max_inflow_change = 0
   449→            max_outflow_change = 0
   450→            
   451→            # Check all gates affecting this node
   452→            for gate_id, (upstream, downstream) in self.hydraulic_solver.gates.items():
   453→                if gate_id in gate_plans:
   454→                    plan = gate_plans[gate_id]
   455→                    flow_change = abs(plan.steps[-1].expected_flow - plan.steps[0].expected_flow)
   456→                    
   457→                    if downstream == node_id:
   458→                        max_inflow_change += flow_change
   459→                    elif upstream == node_id:
   460→                        max_outflow_change += flow_change
   461→            
   462→            # Calculate required buffer (simplified)
   463→            total_change = max_inflow_change + max_outflow_change
   464→            if total_change > 0:
   465→                # Buffer = flow change * transition time / 2
   466→                buffer_volume = total_change * max(p.duration_s for p in gate_plans.values()) / 2
   467→                buffers[node_id] = buffer_volume
   468→        
   469→        return buffers
   470→    
   471→    async def _predict_transition_impacts(
   472→        self,
   473→        gate_plans: Dict[str, GateTransitionPlan]
   474→    ) -> Dict[str, any]:
   475→        """Predict system impacts during transition"""
   476→        impacts = {
   477→            "max_velocity_change": 0,
   478→            "max_level_change": 0,
   479→            "affected_nodes": [],
   480→            "flow_disruption_risk": "low",
   481→            "estimated_stabilization_time": 0
   482→        }
   483→        
   484→        # Run simplified prediction
   485→        # In production, would run full hydraulic simulation
   486→        
   487→        # Estimate maximum changes
   488→        total_flow_change = sum(
   489→            abs(plan.steps[-1].expected_flow - plan.steps[0].expected_flow)
   490→            for plan in gate_plans.values()
   491→        )
   492→        
   493→        impacts["max_velocity_change"] = total_flow_change / 10  # Rough estimate
   494→        impacts["max_level_change"] = total_flow_change / 100  # Rough estimate
   495→        
   496→        # Risk assessment
   497→        if total_flow_change > 5.0:
   498→            impacts["flow_disruption_risk"] = "high"
   499→        elif total_flow_change > 2.0:
   500→            impacts["flow_disruption_risk"] = "medium"
   501→        
   502→        # Stabilization time estimate
   503→        max_duration = max(p.duration_s for p in gate_plans.values())
   504→        impacts["estimated_stabilization_time"] = max_duration * 1.5
   505→        
   506→        return impacts
   507→    
   508→    async def _execute_with_monitoring(
   509→        self,
   510→        plan: SystemTransitionPlan,
   511→        monitoring_interval_s: float,
   512→        results: Dict
   513→    ):
   514→        """Execute transition plan with continuous monitoring"""
   515→        start_time = datetime.now()
   516→        last_monitoring = start_time
   517→        
   518→        # Create tasks for each gate
   519→        gate_tasks = []
   520→        for gate_id, gate_plan in plan.gate_plans.items():
   521→            task = asyncio.create_task(
   522→                self._execute_gate_transition(gate_id, gate_plan, results)
   523→            )
   524→            gate_tasks.append(task)
   525→        
   526→        # Monitor while gates are transitioning
   527→        monitoring_task = asyncio.create_task(
   528→            self._monitor_transition(plan, monitoring_interval_s, results)
   529→        )
   530→        
   531→        # Wait for all gates to complete
   532→        await asyncio.gather(*gate_tasks)
   533→        
   534→        # Stop monitoring
   535→        monitoring_task.cancel()
   536→        try:
   537→            await monitoring_task
   538→        except asyncio.CancelledError:
   539→            pass
   540→        
   541→        logger.info(f"Transition plan {plan.plan_id} execution completed")
   542→    
   543→    async def _execute_gate_transition(
   544→        self,
   545→        gate_id: str,
   546→        plan: GateTransitionPlan,
   547→        results: Dict
   548→    ):
   549→        """Execute transition for a single gate"""
   550→        logger.info(f"Starting transition for gate {gate_id}")
   551→        
   552→        start_time = datetime.now()
   553→        
   554→        try:
   555→            for i, step in enumerate(plan.steps):
   556→                # Wait for the right time
   557→                elapsed = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
   558→                wait_time = step.time_offset_s - elapsed
   559→                if wait_time > 0:
   560→                    await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
   561→                
   562→                # Check for emergency stop
   563→                if gate_id not in self._active_transitions:
   564→                    logger.warning(f"Gate {gate_id} transition cancelled")
   565→                    break
   566→                
   567→                # Apply gate position
   568→                self.hydraulic_solver.current_state.gate_openings[gate_id] = step.gate_position
   569→                
   570→                # Hold if required
   571→                if step.hold_duration_s > 0:
   572→                    await asyncio.sleep(step.hold_duration_s)
   573→                
   574→                logger.debug(f"Gate {gate_id} at position {step.gate_position:.2f}m "
   575→                           f"(step {i+1}/{len(plan.steps)})")
   576→            
   577→            results["final_positions"][gate_id] = plan.target_position
   578→            logger.info(f"Gate {gate_id} transition completed")
   579→            
   580→        except Exception as e:
   581→            logger.error(f"Error during gate {gate_id} transition: {e}")
   582→            results["anomalies"].append({
   583→                "gate_id": gate_id,
   584→                "error": str(e),
   585→                "timestamp": datetime.now()
   586→            })
   587→    
   588→    async def _monitor_transition(
   589→        self,
   590→        plan: SystemTransitionPlan,
   591→        interval_s: float,
   592→        results: Dict
   593→    ):
   594→        """Monitor system during transition"""
   595→        logger.info("Starting transition monitoring")
   596→        
   597→        try:
   598→            while True:
   599→                # Get current system state
   600→                monitoring_data = await self._collect_monitoring_data()
   601→                
   602→                # Store in history
   603→                self._monitoring_history.append(monitoring_data)
   604→                
   605→                # Check for anomalies
   606→                anomalies = self._detect_anomalies(monitoring_data)
   607→                if anomalies:
   608→                    monitoring_data.anomalies.extend(anomalies)
   609→                    results["anomalies"].extend(anomalies)
   610→                
   611→                # Check hydraulic condition
   612→                condition = self._assess_hydraulic_condition(monitoring_data)
   613→                monitoring_data.hydraulic_condition = condition
   614→                
   615→                # Take action based on condition
   616→                if condition == HydraulicCondition.SHOCK_DETECTED:
   617→                    logger.critical("Hydraulic shock detected! Emergency stop initiated")
   618→                    await self._emergency_stop_all()
   619→                    results["emergency_stops"].append({
   620→                        "reason": "Hydraulic shock detected",
   621→                        "timestamp": datetime.now(),
   622→                        "monitoring_data": monitoring_data
   623→                    })
   624→                    break
   625→                elif condition == HydraulicCondition.SHOCK_RISK:
   626→                    logger.warning("Shock risk detected - slowing transitions")
   627→                    await self._slow_all_transitions()
   628→                elif condition == HydraulicCondition.MAJOR_OSCILLATION:
   629→                    logger.warning("Major oscillations detected - damping applied")
   630→                    await self._apply_oscillation_damping()
   631→                
   632→                await asyncio.sleep(interval_s)
   633→                
   634→        except asyncio.CancelledError:
   635→            logger.info("Transition monitoring stopped")
   636→    
   637→    async def _collect_monitoring_data(self) -> TransitionMonitoringData:
   638→        """Collect current system monitoring data"""
   639→        state = self.hydraulic_solver.current_state
   640→        
   641→        # Calculate velocities (simplified)
   642→        velocities = {}
   643→        for section_id, flow in state.canal_flows.items():
   644→            # Rough velocity estimate
   645→            velocities[section_id] = abs(flow) / 5.0  # Assuming 5m² area
   646→        
   647→        return TransitionMonitoringData(
   648→            timestamp=datetime.now(),
   649→            gate_positions=state.gate_openings.copy(),
   650→            water_levels=state.water_levels.copy(),
   651→            flow_rates=state.gate_flows.copy(),
   652→            velocities=velocities,
   653→            hydraulic_condition=HydraulicCondition.STABLE
   654→        )
   655→    
   656→    def _detect_anomalies(self, data: TransitionMonitoringData) -> List[str]:
   657→        """Detect anomalies in monitoring data"""
   658→        anomalies = []
   659→        
   660→        # Check for sudden level changes
   661→        for node_id, level in data.water_levels.items():
   662→            history = self._oscillation_detectors[node_id]
   663→            history.append(level)
   664→            
   665→            if len(history) > 1:
   666→                change = abs(level - history[-2])
   667→                if change > self.constraints.emergency_stop_threshold:
   668→                    anomalies.append(f"Sudden level change at {node_id}: {change:.2f}m")
   669→        
   670→        # Check for high velocities
   671→        for section_id, velocity in data.velocities.items():
   672→            if velocity > self.constraints.max_velocity_m_per_s:
   673→                anomalies.append(f"High velocity in {section_id}: {velocity:.1f} m/s")
   674→        
   675→        return anomalies
   676→    
   677→    def _assess_hydraulic_condition(self, data: TransitionMonitoringData) -> HydraulicCondition:
   678→        """Assess overall hydraulic condition"""
   679→        # Check for oscillations
   680→        oscillation_score = 0
   681→        
   682→        for node_id, history in self._oscillation_detectors.items():
   683→            if len(history) >= 3:
   684→                # Check for alternating changes (oscillation pattern)
   685→                changes = [history[i] - history[i-1] for i in range(1, len(history))]
   686→                sign_changes = sum(1 for i in range(1, len(changes)) 
   687→                                 if np.sign(changes[i]) != np.sign(changes[i-1]))
   688→                
   689→                if sign_changes >= 2:
   690→                    oscillation_score += 1
   691→        
   692→        # Determine condition
   693→        if any("Sudden level change" in a for a in data.anomalies):
   694→            return HydraulicCondition.SHOCK_DETECTED
   695→        elif any(v > self.constraints.max_velocity_m_per_s * 0.9 for v in data.velocities.values()):
   696→            return HydraulicCondition.SHOCK_RISK
   697→        elif oscillation_score > len(self._oscillation_detectors) * 0.3:
   698→            return HydraulicCondition.MAJOR_OSCILLATION
   699→        elif oscillation_score > 0:
   700→            return HydraulicCondition.MINOR_OSCILLATION
   701→        else:
   702→            return HydraulicCondition.STABLE
   703→    
   704→    async def _emergency_stop_all(self):
   705→        """Emergency stop all active transitions"""
   706→        logger.critical("EMERGENCY STOP - Halting all gate movements")
   707→        self._active_transitions.clear()
   708→        # In production, would also send stop commands to SCADA
   709→    
   710→    async def _slow_all_transitions(self):
   711→        """Slow down all active transitions"""
   712→        damping = 0.5
   713→        for gate_id, plan in self._active_transitions.items():
   714→            # Increase time offsets for remaining steps
   715→            for step in plan.steps:
   716→                if step.time_offset_s > (datetime.now() - plan.created_at).total_seconds():
   717→                    step.time_offset_s *= (1 + damping)
   718→    
   719→    async def _apply_oscillation_damping(self):
   720→        """Apply damping to reduce oscillations"""
   721→        damping = self.constraints.oscillation_damping_factor
   722→        for gate_id, plan in self._active_transitions.items():
   723→            # Add holds between steps
   724→            for step in plan.steps:
   725→                step.hold_duration_s = max(step.hold_duration_s, 5.0)
   726→    
   727→    def get_active_transitions(self) -> Dict[str, GateTransitionPlan]:
   728→        """Get currently active transitions"""
   729→        return self._active_transitions.copy()
   730→    
   731→    def get_monitoring_history(self, duration_s: float = 300) -> List[TransitionMonitoringData]:
   732→        """Get recent monitoring history"""
   733→        cutoff_time = datetime.now() - timedelta(seconds=duration_s)
   734→        return [data for data in self._monitoring_history 
   735→                if data.timestamp > cutoff_time]

## Summary of Claude Instance 16: Core Flow Monitoring with Dual-Mode Control

I've completed my analysis of the implementation for Tasks 50, 59, and 65. Here's what I found:

### Task 50 - Flow/Volume/Level Monitoring Service ✓ Implemented
The service includes:
- **Calibrated gate flow equations**: Q = Cs × L × Hs × √(2g × ΔH) where Cs = K1 × (Hs/Go)^K2
- **Enhanced hydraulic solver** with iterative network-wide water level calculation
- **Path-based flow calculation** for multi-zone deliveries
- **Confidence scoring** for ungauged locations
- **Real-time data ingestion** via Kafka
- **Multiple database support** (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL, Redis)

### Task 59 - Dual-Mode Gate Control System ✓ Implemented
The `DualModeGateController` provides:
- **Gate classification** (automated/manual/hybrid)
- **Real-time PID control** for automated gates (prefixes: HG-C, CHK, RG)
- **Manual instruction generator** for field teams
- **Synchronization protocol** preventing conflicts
- **State tracking** for all gates with mode transitions
- **Fallback procedures** for automated gate failures

### Task 65 - Mode Transition System ✓ Implemented
The `GradualTransitionController` handles:
- **Automatic mode selection** based on conditions
- **State preservation** during transitions
- **Gradual transition capabilities** with multiple strategies (linear, exponential, S-curve, adaptive)
- **Emergency transition protocols** with hydraulic shock prevention
- **Performance tracking** in both modes

### Key Integration Points:
1. **SCADA Integration** (Port 3015) - OPC UA protocol for automated gates
2. **Sensor Data Service** - Raw sensor ingestion via Kafka
3. **Field Operations Service** (Port 3031) - Manual gate coordination
4. **Gravity Optimization Service** (Port 3010) - Optimal flow calculations
5. **BFF/GraphQL** - Frontend API aggregation
6. **Multiple databases**:
   - InfluxDB: Real-time sensor data
   - TimescaleDB: Historical aggregations
   - PostgreSQL: Configuration and state
   - Redis: Caching and session management

### API Endpoints:
- `/api/v1/gates/state` - Get all gate states
- `/api/v1/gates/manual/{gate_id}/state` - Update manual gate position
- `/api/v1/gates/mode/transition` - Request mode changes
- `/api/v1/gates/manual/instructions` - Get field team instructions
- `/api/v1/hydraulics/model` - Get hydraulic model results
- `/api/v1/hydraulics/model/propagation` - Simulate water flow

The implementation follows the design principles with no conflicts between manual and automated operations, graceful degradation on failures, complete state tracking, and full audit trails.

## Operational Modes

The system needs to support transitions between these primary modes:

### 1. **Automated Mode**
- Used for the 20 gates with SCADA integration
- Real-time PID control
- Continuous monitoring and adjustment
- Sensor-driven decisions

### 2. **Manual Mode** 
- Used for gates without automation
- Weekly batch operations
- Field team receives instructions
- Manual valve adjustments

### 3. **Hybrid Mode**
- Some gates automated, others manual
- Coordinated operations
- Most common operational state

### 4. **Emergency Mode**
- Activated during system failures
- All gates switch to manual control
- Preservation of system state
- Safety protocols engaged

## Mode Transitions

Task 65 implements the system that handles transitions between these modes:

### Key Transition Scenarios:

1. **Normal → Emergency**
   - When automated gate failures exceed threshold
   - When communication with SCADA is lost
   - During critical sensor failures

2. **Emergency → Normal**
   - After system recovery
   - Gradual transition with validation
   - State synchronization

3. **Automated → Manual** (for specific gates)
   - During maintenance windows
   - When gate automation fails
   - For special operations

4. **Manual → Automated** (for specific gates)
   - After maintenance completion
   - When installing new automation
   - During system upgrades

## Transition Features (from Task 65)

1. **Automatic Mode Selection**
   - Based on system health
   - Gate availability status
   - Operational requirements

2. **State Preservation**
   - Current gate positions
   - Flow targets
   - Active delivery schedules

3. **Gradual Transition**
   - Prevents hydraulic shocks
   - Maintains downstream deliveries
   - Smooth handover between control systems

4. **Emergency Protocols**
   - Immediate safe-state positioning
   - Alert notifications
   - Fallback procedures activation

The critical aspect is ensuring that manual and automated operations never conflict, maintaining state consistency across all modes, and providing seamless service to farmers regardless of which mode is active.

## 1. SCADA Availability Check

The SCADA availability check would involve multiple layers:

### Health Check Implementation
```python
class SCADAHealthChecker:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scada_service_url = "http://scada-service:3015"  # Internal service
        self.health_threshold = {
            "response_time_ms": 5000,
            "consecutive_failures": 3,
            "data_staleness_seconds": 300  # 5 minutes
        }
    
    async def check_availability(self) -> SCADAStatus:
        checks = {
            "connectivity": await self._check_connectivity(),
            "data_freshness": await self._check_data_freshness(),
            "command_response": await self._check_command_capability(),
            "gate_communication": await self._check_gate_status()
        }
        
        return SCADAStatus(
            available=all(checks.values()),
            details=checks,
            timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
        )
```

- **SCADA Integration Service** (Task 15): Primary interface to GE iFix OPC UA
- **Sensor Data Service**: For real-time sensor readings validation
- **Alert Management Service**: To receive SCADA failure notifications
- **Redis Cache**: For storing SCADA health status with TTL

```python
            "total_system": {
                "max_failure_percentage": 30,  # 6 out of 20 gates
                "critical_gate_failures": 1     # Any critical gate
            }
        }
    
    def should_trigger_emergency(self, failed_gates: List[Gate]) -> bool:
        # Count failures by category
        critical_failures = sum(1 for g in failed_gates if g.is_critical)
        total_failures = len(failed_gates)
        failure_percentage = (total_failures / TOTAL_AUTOMATED_GATES) * 100
        
        # Emergency if ANY condition met:
        return (
            critical_failures >= self.thresholds["total_system"]["critical_gate_failures"] or
            failure_percentage >= self.thresholds["total_system"]["max_failure_percentage"] or
            self._check_cascade_risk(failed_gates)  # Adjacent gates failing
        )
```

```python
class StatePreservationManager:
    def __init__(self, redis_client, timescale_db):

            gate_positions=await self._capture_gate_positions(),
            flow_targets=await self._capture_flow_targets(),

    async def _capture_gate_positions(self) -> Dict[str, GatePosition]:
        """Capture current position of all gates"""
        positions = {}

                "flow_rate_m3s": await self._get_current_flow(gate_id),

                "last_command": await self._get_last_command(gate_id),
```

## 4. Gradual Transition Implementation

### Hydraulic Shock Prevention
```python
class GradualTransitionController:
    def __init__(self):
        self.max_flow_change_rate = 0.1  # m³/s per minute
        self.max_gate_movement_rate = 5  # % per minute
        self.transition_steps = 10  # Number of steps for smooth transition
        
    async def execute_gradual_transition(
        self, 
        from_state: SystemState, 
        to_state: SystemState,
        transition_time_minutes: int = 30
    ):
        steps = self._calculate_transition_steps(from_state, to_state)
        
        for step in steps:
            # Apply gradual changes
            await self._apply_gate_adjustments(step.gate_changes)
            
            # Monitor hydraulic response
            hydraulic_state = await self._monitor_hydraulic_conditions()
            
            # Adjust if shock detected
            if hydraulic_state.shock_risk > SHOCK_THRESHOLD:
                await self._reduce_transition_rate(step)
            
            # Validate downstream conditions
            await self._validate_downstream_delivery(step)
            
            await asyncio.sleep(step.duration_seconds)
    
    def _calculate_transition_steps(self, from_state, to_state) -> List[TransitionStep]:
        """Calculate intermediate steps to prevent shocks"""
        steps = []
        
        for gate_id, from_pos in from_state.gate_positions.items():
            to_pos = to_state.gate_positions[gate_id]
            position_change = to_pos.opening_percentage - from_pos.opening_percentage
            
            # Calculate steps based on maximum safe rate
            num_steps = max(
                abs(position_change) / self.max_gate_movement_rate,
                self.transition_steps
            )
            
            for i in range(int(num_steps)):
                progress = (i + 1) / num_steps
                steps.append(TransitionStep(
                    gate_id=gate_id,
                    target_position=from_pos.opening_percentage + (position_change * progress),
                    flow_target=self._interpolate_flow(from_pos.flow_rate_m3s, to_pos.flow_rate_m3s, progress),
                    step_number=i,
                    duration_seconds=60  # 1 minute per step
                ))
        
        return steps
```

### Downstream Delivery Maintenance
```python
class DownstreamProtection:
    async def maintain_deliveries_during_transition(self, transition_plan: TransitionPlan):
        # Identify affected downstream zones
        affected_zones = await self._identify_affected_zones(transition_plan)
        
        for zone in affected_zones:
            # Calculate minimum required flow
            min_flow = await self._calculate_minimum_flow(zone)
            
            # Ensure flow never drops below minimum
            transition_plan.add_constraint(
                zone_id=zone.id,
                constraint_type="minimum_flow",
                value=min_flow
            )
            
            # Pre-position upstream gates if needed
            if zone.requires_buffer:
                await self._create_water_buffer(zone, transition_plan)
    
    async def _create_water_buffer(self, zone: Zone, plan: TransitionPlan):
        """Pre-fill canals to maintain pressure during transition"""
        buffer_volume = zone.transition_buffer_m3
        upstream_gates = await self._get_upstream_gates(zone)
        
        # Open upstream gates slightly more before transition
        pre_transition_phase = plan.add_phase(
            name="buffer_creation",
            duration_minutes=15,
            gates=upstream_gates,
            target_flow_increase=buffer_volume / (15 * 60)  # m³/s
        )
```

### Smooth Handover Protocol
```python
class HandoverProtocol:
    async def handover_gate_control(self, gate_id: str, from_mode: Mode, to_mode: Mode):
        # 1. Parallel operation phase (both systems active)
        await self._enable_shadow_mode(gate_id, to_mode)
        
        # 2. Validate new system tracking correctly
        validation_period = timedelta(minutes=5)
        is_valid = await self._validate_shadow_operation(gate_id, validation_period)
        
        if not is_valid:
            await self._abort_handover(gate_id)
            return False
        
        # 3. Gradual control transfer
        control_weights = [
            (0.9, 0.1),  # 90% old, 10% new
            (0.7, 0.3),
            (0.5, 0.5),
            (0.3, 0.7),
            (0.1, 0.9),
            (0.0, 1.0)   # 100% new system
        ]
        
        for old_weight, new_weight in control_weights:
            await self._apply_weighted_control(gate_id, from_mode, to_mode, old_weight, new_weight)
            await asyncio.sleep(60)  # 1 minute per step
            
            # Monitor for anomalies
            if await self._detect_anomaly(gate_id):
                await self._rollback_handover(gate_id, from_mode)
                return False
        
        # 4. Finalize handover
        await self._finalize_handover(gate_id, to_mode)
        return True
```

## 3. State Preservation - Detailed Description

### Overview
State preservation is a critical mechanism that captures a complete snapshot of the irrigation system at the moment of mode transition. This ensures that no operational data is lost and the system can resume operations seamlessly after the transition.

### Current Gate Positions
**What to Capture:**
- Physical opening percentage (0-100%) for each gate
- Actual flow rate through the gate (m³/s) from sensors or calculated
- Control mode status (automated/manual/transitioning)
- Last command sent and its timestamp
- Current sensor readings (upstream/downstream water levels)
- Gate health status and any active alarms

**Storage Strategy:**
- Store in both fast-access memory (Redis) and persistent database (TimescaleDB)
- Use a versioned snapshot approach with unique transition IDs
- Include metadata about why the position was set (e.g., delivery ID, optimization result)
- Maintain a rolling history of the last 24 hours of positions for trend analysis

### Flow Targets
**What to Capture:**
- Zone-level water demand targets (m³/s) for each irrigation zone
- Individual gate flow targets derived from zone demands
- Time windows for each flow target (start time, duration, priority)
- Upstream/downstream dependencies between targets
- Optimization constraints that led to current targets
- Any active flow reduction factors due to water scarcity

**Preservation Method:**
- Create a hierarchical structure: System → Zones → Gates
- Link flow targets to their source (farmer request, scheduled irrigation, emergency)
- Store both the original requested flow and the optimized/allocated flow
- Include calculation audit trail showing how targets were derived

### Active Delivery Schedules
**What to Capture:**
- Currently executing water deliveries with their progress percentage
- Queued deliveries waiting to start
- Delivery paths through the canal network
- Estimated completion times and water volumes
- Associated farmer/field information
- Priority levels and any special handling requirements

**Critical Information:**
- Travel time calculations for water to reach each delivery point
- Dependencies between deliveries (which must complete before others start)
- Resource allocation (which gates are reserved for which deliveries)
- Any delivery modifications made during execution

## 4. Gradual Transition - Detailed Description

### Hydraulic Shock Prevention

**Understanding Hydraulic Shocks:**
Hydraulic shocks occur when sudden changes in flow create pressure waves through the canal system. In gravity-fed irrigation systems, these can cause:
- Canal bank overflow or erosion
- Damage to gate structures
- Disruption of downstream water supply
- Sediment disturbance affecting water quality

**Prevention Strategy:**
1. **Rate Limiting**: Never change gate positions faster than 5% per minute
2. **Cascade Timing**: When multiple gates must move, start from downstream and work upstream with calculated delays
3. **Flow Balancing**: Ensure total system inflow matches outflow during transition
4. **Pressure Wave Modeling**: Calculate expected wave propagation and time gate movements to prevent wave amplification
5. **Buffer Zones**: Use canal storage capacity to absorb flow variations

**Implementation Approach:**
- Calculate transition trajectory for each gate based on hydraulic modeling
- Divide large transitions into multiple small steps
- Monitor water level sensors for unexpected variations
- Implement automatic slowdown if rapid level changes detected
- Use predictive algorithms to anticipate and prevent shock conditions

### Downstream Delivery Maintenance

**Challenge:**
During mode transitions, farmers depending on water delivery must not experience interruptions. This is especially critical during:
- Peak irrigation periods
- Crop critical growth stages
- Previously scheduled delivery windows

**Maintenance Strategy:**

1. **Pre-Transition Analysis**:
   - Map all active and scheduled deliveries
   - Identify which deliveries could be affected by the transition
   - Calculate minimum flow requirements for each delivery point
   - Determine alternative flow paths if primary routes are affected

2. **Buffer Creation**:
   - Before transition begins, slightly overfill canal sections downstream of transition points
   - This creates a water buffer that maintains supply during gate movements
   - Calculate required buffer volume based on transition duration and downstream demand

3. **Priority-Based Protection**:
   - Classify deliveries by criticality (crop stage, contracted time, volume remaining)
   - Ensure high-priority deliveries are protected first
   - Implement "delivery shields" that prevent flow reduction below critical thresholds

4. **Dynamic Rerouting**:
   - If normal flow paths are disrupted, automatically calculate alternative routes
   - Use network flow algorithms to find optimal paths through available gates
   - Adjust upstream gates to compensate for any flow restrictions

### Smooth Handover Between Control Systems

**Handover Complexity:**
Transitioning control between automated and manual systems (or vice versa) requires careful coordination to prevent:
- Control conflicts (both systems trying to move the same gate)
- Data inconsistencies (different position readings)
- Command loss (instructions not reaching gates)
- State divergence (systems having different understanding of current state)

**Handover Protocol:**

1. **Shadow Mode Operation** (5-10 minutes):
   - New control system operates in parallel but doesn't send commands
   - Monitors and predicts what commands it would send
   - Validates its understanding matches actual system behavior
   - Builds confidence before taking control

2. **Gradual Authority Transfer** (15-30 minutes):
   - Control authority shifts gradually from old to new system
   - Weighted average of commands from both systems
   - Monitors for divergence between systems
   - Can quickly roll back if issues detected

3. **Validation Checkpoints**:
   - At each stage, verify new system is tracking correctly
   - Compare commanded vs actual positions
   - Ensure downstream flows remain stable
   - Check that all safety constraints are maintained

4. **Communication Synchronization**:
   - Ensure both systems have consistent view of gate states
   - Synchronize command queues to prevent conflicts
   - Implement clear ownership tokens for each gate
   - Maintain audit log of all control transfers

5. **Fallback Procedures**:
   - If handover fails, system can quickly revert to previous mode
   - Preserved state allows rollback without disrupting operations
   - Emergency protocols engage if both systems fail
   - Manual override always available as last resort

**Success Criteria:**
- No farmer notices the transition occurred
- Water delivery targets maintained within 5% tolerance
- No hydraulic disturbances exceeding safety thresholds
- Complete audit trail of all transition actions
- System performance metrics remain within normal bounds

   153→
   154→### Flow Rate Calculation
   155→- **Manning's Equation**: Q = (1/n) × A × R^(2/3) × S^(1/2)
   156→- **Velocity-Area Method**: Q = Σ(v_i × A_i)
   157→- **Rating Curves**: Q = a × (h - h₀)^b
   158→
   159→### Water Propagation
   160→- **Saint-Venant Equations**: 
   161→  - Continuity: ∂A/∂t + ∂Q/∂x = q_l
   162→  - Momentum: ∂Q/∂t + ∂(Q²/A)/∂x + gA(∂h/∂x) = gA(S₀ - Sf)

   124→    def calculate_gate_flow(self, gate_id: str) -> float:

   141→

   151→        result = self.gate_hydraulics.calculate_gate_flow(gate_props, conditions)

   155→    def calculate_node_continuity(self, node: str) -> float:
   156→        """
   157→        Calculate flow imbalance at a node
   158→        Positive = excess inflow, Negative = excess outflow
   159→        """
   160→        
   161→        inflow = 0.0
   162→        outflow = 0.0
   163→        
   164→        # Sum all flows connected to this node
   165→        for gate_id, (upstream, downstream) in self.gates.items():
   166→            flow = self.flows.get(gate_id, 0)
   167→            
   168→            if downstream == node:
   169→                inflow += flow
   170→            elif upstream == node:
   171→                outflow += flow
   172→        
   173→        # Special case for source
   174→        if node == 'Source':
   175→            # Source can provide any required flow
   176→            return 0.0
   177→        
   178→        return inflow - outflow
   179→    
   180→    def update_node_level(self, node: str, flow_imbalance: float, dt: float = 60.0):
   181→        """
   182→        Update water level based on flow imbalance
   183→        Uses simplified storage routing
   184→        """
   185→        
   186→        if node == 'Source':
   187→            return  # Source level is fixed
   188→        
   189→        # Estimate node surface area (simplified)
   190→        # Larger nodes have more storage
   191→        if 'M(0,' in node and ')' == node[-1]:  # Main canal node
   192→            surface_area = 5000.0  # m²
   193→        else:
   194→            surface_area = 1000.0  # m²
   195→        
   196→        # Change in water level
   197→        dh = (flow_imbalance * dt) / surface_area
   198→        
   199→        # Apply with relaxation
   200→        new_level = self.water_levels[node] + self.relaxation_factor * dh
   201→        
   202→        # Constraints
   203→        min_level = self.canal_inverts[node] + 0.1  # Minimum 10cm depth
   204→        max_level = self.canal_inverts[node] + 5.0  # Maximum 5m depth
   205→        
   206→        self.water_levels[node] = np.clip(new_level, min_level, max_level)
   207→    
   208→    def calculate_canal_head_loss(self, upstream: str, downstream: str, flow: float) -> float:
   209→        """Calculate head loss in canal reach"""
   210→        
   211→        key = f"{upstream}->{downstream}"
   212→        
   213→        if key not in self.canal_sections or flow <= 0:
   214→            return 0.0
   215→        
   216→        section = self.canal_sections[key]
   217→        
   218→        # Calculate normal depth and velocity
   219→        y_normal = self.controller.calculate_normal_depth(flow, section)
   220→        velocity = self.controller.calculate_velocity(flow, section)
   221→        
   222→        # Calculate hydraulic radius
   223→        b = section.bottom_width_m
   224→        m = section.side_slope
   225→        A = b * y_normal + m * y_normal * y_normal
   226→        P = b + 2 * y_normal * np.sqrt(1 + m * m)
   227→        R = A / P if P > 0 else 0.1
   228→        
   229→        # Friction slope
   230→        Sf = (section.manning_n * velocity) ** 2 / (R ** (4/3))
   231→        
   232→        # Head loss
   233→        return Sf * section.length_m

   235→    def solve_network(self, gate_settings: List[Dict]) -> ConvergenceResult:
   236→        """
   237→        Solve for steady-state water levels and flows
   238→        gate_settings: [{'upstream': str, 'downstream': str, 'opening': float}]
   239→        """
   240→        
   241→        # Set gate openings
   242→        for setting in gate_settings:
   243→            self.set_gate_opening(
   244→                setting['upstream'],
   245→                setting['downstream'],
   246→                setting['opening']
   247→            )
   248→        
   249→        # Initialize flows
   250→        for gate_id in self.gates:
   251→            self.flows[gate_id] = self.calculate_gate_flow(gate_id)
   252→        
   253→        # Iterative solution
   254→        converged = False
   255→        iteration = 0
   256→        warnings = []
   257→        
   258→        print("\nIterative Hydraulic Solution:")
   259→        print("-" * 60)
   260→        
   261→        while iteration < self.max_iterations and not converged:
   262→            iteration += 1
   263→            
   264→            # Store previous levels for convergence check
   265→            prev_levels = self.water_levels.copy()
   266→            
   267→            # Step 1: Update flows based on current water levels
   268→            for gate_id in self.gates:
   269→                self.flows[gate_id] = self.calculate_gate_flow(gate_id)
   270→            
   271→            # Step 2: Update water levels based on continuity
   272→            for node in self.nodes:
   273→                if node == 'Source':
   274→                    continue
   275→                
   276→                # Calculate flow imbalance
   277→                imbalance = self.calculate_node_continuity(node)
   278→                
   279→                # Update level
   280→                self.update_node_level(node, imbalance)
   281→            
   282→            # Step 3: Apply canal head losses
   283→            for gate_id, (upstream, downstream) in self.gates.items():
   284→                flow = self.flows[gate_id]
   285→                if flow > 0:
   286→                    # Calculate head loss
   287→                    head_loss = self.calculate_canal_head_loss(upstream, downstream, flow)
   288→                    
   289→                    # Adjust downstream level (simplified approach)
   290→                    # In reality, would solve backwater curve
   291→                    expected_downstream = self.water_levels[upstream] - head_loss
   292→                    
   293→                    # Blend with continuity-based level
   294→                    current = self.water_levels[downstream]
   295→                    self.water_levels[downstream] = (
   296→                        0.5 * current + 0.5 * expected_downstream
   297→                    )
   298→            
   299→            # Check convergence
   300→            max_change = 0.0
   301→            for node in self.nodes:
   302→                if node != 'Source':
   303→                    change = abs(self.water_levels[node] - prev_levels[node])
   304→                    max_change = max(max_change, change)
   305→            
   306→            if iteration % 10 == 0:
   307→                print(f"Iteration {iteration}: Max level change = {max_change:.4f}m")
   308→            
   309→            if max_change < self.tolerance:
   310→                converged = True
   311→        
   312→        # Check for issues
   313→        if not converged:
   314→            warnings.append(f"Did not converge after {iteration} iterations")
   315→        
   316→        # Check for dry nodes
   317→        for node in self.nodes:
   318→            depth = self.water_levels[node] - self.canal_inverts[node]
   319→            if depth < 0.1:
   320→                warnings.append(f"Node {node} is nearly dry (depth={depth:.2f}m)")
   321→        
   322→        print(f"\nConverged: {converged} after {iteration} iterations")
   323→        print(f"Final max error: {max_change:.4f}m")
   324→        
   325→        return ConvergenceResult(
   326→            converged=converged,
   327→            iterations=iteration,
   328→            max_error=max_change,
   329→            node_levels=self.water_levels.copy(),
